run_f_gold: run the f_gold function with an integer n to compute the telescoping sum of i^2 - (i-1)^2
test_f_gold: test the f_gold function against known inputs like 10, 20, 39, 70, 80, 89, 99
refactor_f_gold: refactor the f_gold function to use the closed-form formula n*n instead of a loop
summarize_f_gold: summarize the f_gold function which computes the sum of i^2 - (i-1)^2 from 1 to n
review_f_gold: review the f_gold function that iterates from 1 to n accumulating i*i - (i-1)*(i-1)
